items.quote: She championed emergency coordination during the flood response and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Cyra handled the five-year strategic plan for the division competently within her team.
She took ownership of efforts that helped three direct reports earn promotion and steered it to completion.
Cyra set the direction for negotiations with contractors on the service agreement across the public service.
She led steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled across the department.
She contributed effectively to engagement with industry stakeholders.
Cyra set the direction for cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce across the public service.
She set the direction for media interviews and press conferences across the public service.
